title: Matsvinn first-pass delta
shortVerdict: Created a Norway-first CAR-004 registry delta for food-waste prevention, redistribution, surplus resale, coordination and research/support actors.
strongestSource: Actor-primary pages for Too Good To Go, Holdbart, Matsentralen, Oda, TotalCtrl and Havaristen plus Brreg API checks
weakestPoint: Norway-specific impact, avoided-waste and partner/customer metrics remain incomplete.
gapType: Type A for source/dedupe follow-up; Type B for KPI and participant-level details
ikkeSi: Do not turn targets into achieved reductions.
Do not use global app figures as Norway-specific outcomes.
Do not count program rows as direct actor output.

title: Matsentralen output source is usable but scope-bound
shortVerdict: Matsentralen's annual-report page gives a usable 2024 redistribution figure, but the row must keep it as network output rather than national food-waste prevention coverage.
strongestSource: Matsentralen annual-report page and Brreg identity
weakestPoint: Regional food-bank split and national denominator coverage were not closed in this pass.
ikkeSi: Do not present Matsentralen tonnes as total Norwegian saved food.
Do not infer full national redistribution coverage from network annual output.
Do not mix social-support demand with avoided-waste KPI without method source.

title: Agreement and program rows stay contextual
shortVerdict: Bransjeavtalen and KuttMatsvinn were retained as context/program rows to explain the prevention ecosystem without inflating direct actor coverage.
weakestPoint: Participant compliance and company-level outcomes need separate source handling.
ikkeSi: Do not convert the 2030 halving target into achieved reduction.
Do not count a collaboration program as direct output.
Do not infer participant performance from agreement membership.
